pr.title: fix(dcp): scanner-side control-character fail-closed repair (supersedes test-only draft)
pr.body: Closes a confirmed live bypass: RedLaneScanner silently fails to block exact-match FORBIDDEN_PATHS entries (scripts/dopetask, scripts/taskx, queue_drain.py variants, batch_resolve_and_merge.py) when the path carries a trailing or embedded control character, because the \Z re-anchoring in PR #1322 correctly fixed the wildcard rules but regressed these exact-match rules on the one consumer (the scanner) that lacks the hook's independent control-character short-circuit. Adds an unconditional scanner-side fail-closed check mirroring the hook's, plus regression coverage for exact-match, wildcard, exemption-spoof, arbitrary-malformed, and clean-control cases. Supersedes this PR's prior test-only scope, which automated review correctly identified as insufficient. Does not merge.

steps.task: Re-verify the live bypass and current main identity before implementing.
requirements: A dedicated worktree is created (or an existing one is fetched and re-verified) from the current origin/main tip, not merely checked to contain an old ancestor SHA.

The execution HEAD used for implementation is asserted EQUAL to origin/main at fetch time -- not merely an ancestor of it. A HEAD that is behind origin/main is an ancestor of it (git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main succeeds even when stale), so ancestry alone is not sufficient: the check must reject inequality outright and require an actual fast-forward (or fresh checkout) before proceeding, never silently accept a stale-but-ancestor tree.
PR #1322 confirmed merged and its content present in red_lane_rules.py.
The five exact-match probes independently reproduced as Status.UNKNOWN (bypass) against the verified, up-to-date execution HEAD before any change.
commands: if [ "$HEAD_SHA" != "$MAIN_SHA" ]; then git merge --ff-only origin/main || { echo "HEAD is not a fast-forward ancestor of origin/main -- stop, do not implement on a diverged tree" >&2; exit 1; }; fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$MAIN_SHA"  # hard equality assertion after the fast-forward, not merely ancestry

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import tempfile; from dopemux.dcp.red_lane_scanner import RedLaneScanner; tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(); s = RedLaneScanner(repo_root=tmp); probes = ['scripts/dopetask
', 'scripts/taskx
', 'dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/queue_drain.py
', 'src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/queue_drain.py
', 'scripts/batch_resolve_and_merge.py
']; [print(p, s.scan(changed_files=[p]).status) for p in probes]"  # must print Status.UNKNOWN for all five before any change
